opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000. The scholarship includes a financial incentive of £1000, to part cover replacement labour cost.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Aimed at young people aged 18-24. Open to applicants from the UK with a demonstrable interest in the relevant sector (for 2027, three dairy and three pig scholarships are planned).
opportunities.summary: A scholarship to develop young talent in agriculture, linking successful applicants directly to farmers via the Nuffield Scholar network. It involves a 30-day study tour (in June/July) staying on farms with Nuffield Scholars, and is fully funded including all travel and subsistence, attendance at the Nuffield Conference, and Nuffield Farming Associate membership. Applications open in November 2026.
